description: The two synthetic .epru DEVICE library streams the differential case book publishes as device-library-sample inputs. A DEVICE document is addressed by its own uuid and its metadata travels in a META, so an entry is the record stream alone, no pinKey, and nothing keyed by an element handle. The V3 case is one DEVICE whose first META wins: every model-visible field is stated once, an empty and a "null" attribute are stated so the golden can show they are not emitted, and a second META states different values so the golden can show it is ignored. The V4 case is one DEVICE uuid copied page by page, the way a V4 export repeats a used part into every page that places it: the second copy differs only in editVersion and in the order its records were written (not a conflict), and the third differs in a model-visible value (first wins, conflictingDocuments counts it). The text below is the whole input: no editor session, container or fixture is read to obtain it, and no line names a real project.
